text: dsh-question-rail 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话导航插件，会在聊天界面右侧的 shell.overlay 中显示问题栏。它从当前会话提取用户和 steering 提问，并将窄条悬停展开为问题列表；切换到非聊天视图或没有问题时隐藏。点击问题可平滑滚动到对应对话位置并短暂高亮，历史分页会继续加载以纳入更多轮次。适合需要快速回看长对话提问的 DSH 网页用户；实现不读取 API 密钥或配置外部服务。

dsh-question-rail adds a question rail to DSH web chats through shell.overlay. It lists session questions, expands on hover, hides outside chat view, and smooth-scrolls to a selected turn with a brief highlight. It loads older history when available. It uses no API key or external service.
想在 DSH 聊天页面快速找到之前问过的问题。
长会话里能不能列出每轮提问，点一下就回到那一轮？
I want a sidebar that lets me jump back to an earlier question in a DSH chat.
dsh-question-rail 的功能「会话问题导航」：在当前聊天右缘列出用户与 steering 提问，悬停展开文字；点击条目后平滑滚动到对应对话锚点并短暂高亮。非聊天视图或没有问题时不显示。
dsh-question-rail 的功能「加载完整历史」：当当前会话仍有旧历史页时，组件持续调用 loadOlder，直到没有更多页面或达到循环上限，让问题栏覆盖已加载的较早轮次。
dsh-question-rail 使用前须知：README 所列 GitHub 安装方式要求本机有 git 和 GitHub token；此要求针对从 GitHub 安装。

dsh-question-rail README · dsh-question-rail：
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) web plugin that adds a **right-edge question rail** like the deepseek.com chat — a narrow strip of ticks on the right edge that expands on hover to list **every user turn in the current conversation**, and jump-scrolls back to that turn when clicked.

dsh-question-rail README · dsh-question-rail：- **One rendering, two states** — the collapsed tick column and the expanded list are the *same* `.qrl_item` elements. Collapsed shows only each item's right-edge tick; hovering widens the panel to reveal the text. Identical style, identical spacing, identical right reference line.
- **Jump to any round** — click a question, and the chat scrolls smoothly to that turn (`data-chat-anchor-key` anchor) with a brief highlight ring.
- **Conversation-only** — reads the live per-session chat store (`view` from `ctx.slots.entries("conversation.session")` + `resolveStore`), so it renders only on the **chat** view and hides instantly on 轨迹 / 上下文 / Design / PPT or the empty home.
- **Full history** — DSH conversation history is windowed (`hasMore`). The rail auto-calls `session.loadOlder()` in a loop until `hasMore === false`, so it lists **all** rounds, not just the loaded window.
- **Performance-tuned** — `useSessions` selects only `current`; the rail subscribes to a **render signature** (question set + active view) instead of the whole conversation snapshot, so streaming output / tool calls don't re-render the list. Skip-free typing, stable handl

dsh-question-rail README · How it works：| Layer | What happens |
|---|---|
| **Node half** (`lib/index.js`) | Empty `apply()` — just enough to be an active cordis loader entry so `dsh-client-modules` publishes `/plugins/dsh-question-rail/client.js`. |
| **Browser half** (`lib/client.js`) | Registers via `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`, then `apply(ctx)` injects the rail into the `shell.overlay` slot (frame-wide, additive, click-through until the entry opts in). |
| **Data** | Reads the current session's `ConversationSnapshot.nodes` (full list, not the windowed `chat.order`), extracts `user`/`steering` turns, and maps each `seq` → chat `key` for scroll anchors. |
| **View gating** | `ctx.slots.entries("conversation.session") → resolveStore(handle, sessionId) → store.getSnapshot().view` — the authoritative source DSH's own header tabs use. Renders only when `view === "chat"`. |

`dsh plugin add` adds the package to the profile's `dependencies`; because the package declares `dsh.bundle`, it is automatically appended to `dsh.profile.bundles`.

> **New client packages need a restart.** `dsh.client` discovery scans only at boot for *new* packages (bundle *content* changes hot-reload). After first install, restart `dsh web` (or the headless runner), then **hard-refresh** the browser (`Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R`).

text: dsh-question-rail README · Usage：Once installed, a narrow strip of ticks appears along the right edge of an active chat conversation:

dsh-question-rail README · Usage：| Interaction | Behavior |
|---|---|
| Move mouse near the right edge | The strip widens, revealing each round's question as a single line (12px, right-aligned, trailing tick). |
| Hover a single question | A detail box appears on the left showing the **full question text** (scrollable up to 50vh). |
| Click a question | The chat scrolls smoothly to that turn and flashes a highlight ring. |
| Switch to 轨迹 / 上下文 / Design / PPT | The rail hides instantly (chat-view gate). |
| Empty / home screen | Nothing renders. |

dsh-question-rail README · dsh-question-rail：
一个模仿 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) 网页版界面**右侧问题条**的 DSH 插件——右缘一条竖向问题栏，常态收起为窄列小横线，鼠标靠近时向右展开，列出当前会话**每一轮的用户提问**，点击后平滑滚动定位到对应位置。

dsh-question-rail README · dsh-question-rail：- **一套渲染、两种状态**——收起态横线列与展开态列表是**同一套 `.qrl_item`**。收起时只露每条右侧的小横线；悬停时面板拉宽显示文字。样式、间距（`min-height:36px` + `3px`）、右侧参考线完全一致。
- **点击跳转任意轮**——点击某条问题，对话区平滑滚动到那一轮（`data-chat-anchor-key` 锚点）并带一圈高亮。
- **仅对话视图渲染**——读取每会话 chat store（`ctx.slots.entries("conversation.session")` + `resolveStore` 的 `view` 字段，与 DSH 头部标签同源），只在**对话**视图显示；切到轨迹 / 上下文 / Design / PPT 或首页立即隐藏。
- **完整历史**——DSH 会话历史是分页窗口（`hasMore`）。问题条自动循环调用 `session.loadOlder()` 直到 `hasMore === false`，列出**全部**轮次而非仅当前窗口。
- **性能优化**——`useSessions` 只选 `current`；订阅「渲染签名」（问题集合 + 当前视图）而非整个会话快照，流式输出 / 工具调用不会重渲染列表（打字不再卡顿）；点击处理用稳定引用、列表按签名 memo。
- **主题适配**——面板文字 & 详情框依据 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]` 切换配色（深色用白字、浅色用黑字）；面板本身透明，无边框、无底色。
- **键盘可达**——每个问题项是 `role="button"` + `tabIndex=0`，支持 Enter/Space 触发。
- **零运行时依赖**——node 半故意为空（仅让加载器发现该包）；浏览器半只用 `react` / `react/jsx-runtime` 两个 seed 词。

dsh-question-rail README · 实现：| 层 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| **node 半**（`lib/index.js`） | 空 `apply()`——只需成为活跃 cordis loader entry，让 `dsh-client-modules` 以 `/plugins/dsh-question-rail/client.js` 提供浏览器半。 |
| **浏览器半**（`lib/client.js`） | 经 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册，`apply(ctx)` 将问题条注入 **`shell.overlay`** 槽位（frame 级浮层、可加性、默认穿透点击）。 |
| **数据** | 读取当前会话的 `ConversationSnapshot.nodes`（完整列表，而非窗口化的 `chat.order`），抽取 `user` / `steering`，并把 `seq` 映射为 chat `key` 用于滚动定位。 |
| **视图门控** | `ctx.slots.entries("conversation.session") → resolveStore(handle, sessionId) → store.getSnapshot().view`——与 DSH 头部标签同源。仅当 `view === "chat"` 时渲染。 |
